https://i.imgur.com/aj8vRtJ.png
Prepare to encounter a new and terrifying menace, The Eye of Terror, a challenging and dynamic mid and end game Crisis. Watch as the experiments or decadence of the Fallen Empires bring forth a progressively more challenging threat. Interwoven with the Shroud and psionic features from the Utopia DLC, the mod aims to change the dynamic of your playthroughs with new stories, challenges and opportunities. This layered crisis will grow in difficulty and will shift depending on the luck or misfortune of your session. While there are encounters that may destroy you, unlike usual crises that spawn massive fleets, its goal is to start off as a constant menace to the galaxy and can only be sealed through great effort. A slow and insidious killer. This mod does not replace the existing crisis and they can occur simultaneously.

Although influenced by HP Lovecraft and the Warhammer Universe event of the same name, the storytelling is built to be immersive, to flow with the lore of Stellaris and aims to make the content feel integrated rather than intrusive. Although the difficulty can be increased for a modded game, its baseline is made for vanilla.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2809452753/4839692156577380383/]TLDR: Visit the FAQ page for a direct explanation of features or if anything is unclear.

https://i.imgur.com/1ZYgDys.png
https://i.imgur.com/ku50ZUe.png
Navigate your empire through 50+ events and multiple story chains leading up to and following the Shroud tear within your galaxy. Explore an ancient Precursor archaeological site to find new ways to combat this enigmatic threat or simply do your best to contain it with your own research chain. Find ways to work together with the Galactic Community with new resolutions, buildings, operations and technologies. Use this new danger as a tool to destroy your enemies, as new Gods to worship or work tirelessly to seal the rifts and free the galaxy from the grip of terror. 

https://i.imgur.com/fSBotUE.png
https://i.imgur.com/OQQu37M.png
Depending on your settings the crisis will have a chance to trigger after reaching midgame.  A slow buildup of events will hint at the upcoming danger as rifts randomly begin to spawn in the galaxy.  During this time, small but manageable enemies will emerge from these rifts to harass your reality. As several decades pass, the Eye of Terror itself will spawn and the chance of truly dangerous adversaries will begin.  If you or the AI are able to seal the major rifts in the galaxy, you will then be able to close off the Eye of Terror. But beware, if it falls into the wrong hands, it can be re-opened.

https://i.imgur.com/zylcBHo.png
https://i.imgur.com/Hr8LHVr.png
Fight a variety of threats crawling out from the Shroud designed to corrupt and devour life in the Galaxy. Different adversaries such as cultists and entities have unique goals and behaviours. The enemy spawn system is built on randomized probability to ensure each playthrough unique and possibly more challenging. Every spawn is individual, meaning if entities or different cults run into each other, they will fight one another -leading to interesting stories or unexpected saviours.

https://i.imgur.com/ibbXHOL.png
The mod is completely independent and affects no vanilla files, it should be playable with all other mods.  It has been tested with large mods (NSC, Giga, etc) and crisis manager mods with no issues (yet). It does not replace the existing crisis, so it is possible that it spawns alongside the others. 

Events are broken if using mods that allow you to be new country types such as an ascended Empire.

Works with multiplayer.

https://i.imgur.com/SR6yWgs.png
Can be added at any point in your saved game, a special popup will appear at the end of the month for spawn chance. No issues that I know of (as of yet).

REQUIRE HIGH GRAPHICS QUALITY TO WORK

https://i.imgur.com/wEFREEP.png

I don't know how you play, but I spend most of my time on the galaxy view, and everything seems so bleak, just dust and some stars. I've been looking for a way to spice things up a bit.
No gameplay impact unfortunately, this is a pure graphical mod.
"High" graphics quality option is required, medium or low won't display the new entities.

http://i.imgur.com/3mUPw2P.png

This mod adds a plethora of visual goodies for your galaxy, regrettably they'll always spawn in the same area, there's no way to randomize it.

Satellite galaxies
https://i.imgur.com/0BIU060.png
https://i.imgur.com/jjHalCQ.gif
There are currently 3 new galaxies added:
 - The first is located at the north west, it has a spiral form and is roughly the same size as ours.
 - The second one is in the south east, a small spiral galaxy that almost touch ours when playing at 1k stars.
 - The third one is in the south south west ans is quite isolated, it is a small elogated spiral galaxy.
All of these are animated and slowly rotate on themselves.

Galactic core
https://i.imgur.com/XvDfy4I.png
https://i.imgur.com/y3f1M6H.gif
The galactic core is empty and quite sad to look at.
Now, we have a proper galactic core, in 3D and, if you look at it close enough, the stars are slowly rotating around.
A little warning, if you zoom too close, you might experience some slow down.

Globular Cluster
https://i.imgur.com/9D60Hig.png
You'll find plenty of globular cluster lying around the galaxy now.

Nebulae in 3D:
https://i.imgur.com/CgHqc8S.png

I've made two addons available for this mod:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445669234]https://i.imgur.com/KjaPnWZ.png
The quadrant addon will add 4 rotating circles to define the various part of the galaxy as well as captions. It is an addon, as many might not like it.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1445669162]https://i.imgur.com/06hKzTp.png
The L-Cluster addon will add animated dust, cpation and some nebulae for the L-Cluster, even before it is discovered. Removed from main mod for people not having distant stars (but they can still use it).

These two addons can now be used as standalone.

http://i.imgur.com/ov0QyWq.png
The mod is completely save game compatible, you can activate/deactivate the mod without any impact. Works on previous save games.

translations.description_clean:
For Stellaris 2.4.1

This mod expands how vassals work. It adds 9 new types of subject empires for default countries (1 for each ethics + 1 for hives), 9 new types of subject empires for megacorporations (1 for each civic) and 12 new types of subject empires and 3 special subject types available under special conditinos. Each subject empire has its own perks. It also adds a new Policy, available once you finish the Domination tradition tree, that let you tax your subjects' trade, and a Proxy War mechanic.

[url=https://github.com/lpslucasps/ver]Fork me on Github!
[url=https://www.patreon.com/lpslucasps]Fund me on Patreon!

FEATURES

New Types of Subject Empires
In vanilla, there are just two kinds of subject empires available to default countries: Vassals and Protectorates. It doesn't matter if you are a democratic crusader or a hegemonic imperialist, the way you treat your subjects is all the same.

In my opinion, to live under the yoke of an authoritarian-xenophobe empire should be different than to be subservient to an egalitarian-xenophile one. The funny thing is, this is exactly how it works with the Fallen Empires. Why not, then, let the players do something similar? With that in mind, now each ethic has access to an exclusive type of subject empire. After you vassalize an empire, an event letting you transform the bland, generic vassals into custom ones is fired, as seen below.

https://i.imgur.com/sMp0UjL.jpg

Some overlord-subject relations are more predatory than others, others are quite benevolent. Not all types of subjects are advantageous, so think before you choose!

https://i.imgur.com/nv2M7Jw.png

If you play as a Corporation, the rules are a bit different. Instead of Ethics, what matters are the Civics of your empire. Corporate Subjects are also all more diplomatically free (all of them being able to wage war and expand) and can't be integrated under any circumstance.

https://i.imgur.com/h9wJFGJ.png

There are also 3 special subject types, available under certain conditions

https://i.imgur.com/olnhdJO.png

If you want to have as many options available as possible, try using the Feudal Society or Franchising Civics - they give you access to almost all new subject types.

https://i.imgur.com/tNL6w73.png

New Policy: Taxation of Subject Empires

After you complete the Domination tradition tree, you can tax part of your subject empires Trade. There are 4 levels of taxation:

[*]No taxation: It's unfair to burden those that are not fully integrated into our society with duties they have not agreed on. Our Subject Empires won't pay any additional taxes.
[*]Light Taxes: Our subjects enjoy our protection and trade. A small contribution is the least we can ask for in return. We'll tax up to 5% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, slightly displeasing them.
[*]Moderate Taxes: Every member of our empire, even those on its periphery, should contribute to its prosperity. We'll tax up to 10% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, displeasing them.
[*]Heavy Taxes: The good of our citizens should be prioritized over any theoretical rights of our client states. We'll tax up to 20% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, greatly displeasing them.
[*]Burdensome Taxes: A subject has no right other than to serve its master. We'll tax up to 30% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, leaving them enraged.

Those policies are not available to nor affect Gestalt Consciousness empires.

Note: Subjects' taxes cap at 10000 Trade Value.

New mechanic: Proxy War

If you have a Puppet State, you gain access to a new mechanic, called Proxy War. Through an edict, you can make a puppet attack a neighboring country. Valid targets must not be in an alliance with you (e.g.: federation) or be a Fallen Empire.

https://i.imgur.com/WprsUph.jpg

LIMITATIONS AND KNOWN ISSUES

[*]Peacefully acquired vassals (diplo-vassalage, protectorates that become vassals, etc) will take up to a month to fire the event that transforms them into custom subject types.
[*]Some effects (lie the taxes from the "Taxation of Subject Empires" policy) may take up to a month to be applied/removed.
[*]The subject's taxes is not exact. The Trade Value "taxed" is added as a modifier to the capital, in 49 steps that go from 5 to 10000.

Translations
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Polish (credits: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198827989904/]promantix)
[*]Russian (credits: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dimuch62]Dimuch62)

FAQ

Is this save-game compatible?
It should be. Do note that any vassal acquired prior to the activation of this mod will take up to a month to be transformed into a custom subject empire.

Is this compatible with petruxa's Cultural Overhaul?
If you want to use both mods together, please, download the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1820403112]Compatibility Patch..

My vassals are useless!
The AI is completely incompetent at everything. To compensante that, they receive a lot of bonuses to stay afloat. Unfortunately, these bonuses are deactivated from players' vassals. This behaviour is hard-coded. If you play on higher difficulties, vassals become a dead-weight. To solve this problem, I recommend using the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1590362799]Dynamic Difficulty. Among its many options, there's one to give player vassals the same bonuses as the AI.

Will the AI use the new subject types?
Yes! They will also, hopefully, make choices based on their own ethic, civics and personalities. So, for instance, Democratic Crusaders are much more likely to turn Vassals into Sister Republics.

I made the wrong choice. How can I change my vassal into another type of subject again?
Your choices are permanent, for the time being. I may add an edict or something like that in the future that let you change your subject empires' type again, but, or now, choose wisely!

translations.title_zh_current: 远古舰船类型
translations.summary_zh_current: 允许玩家在创建新物种时选择「远古」舰船类型，重温千万年前远古文明的辉煌舰船。
translations.description_zh_current:
版本 1.03。本模组让玩家在创建新物种时可以选择「远古」舰船类型。
模组内容：
• 新增充满「远古」主题风格的舰船与空间站模型。
• 新增「远古」城市类型。
• 作者还制作了堕落帝国、海盗、机械、虫群、异维度等舰船类型模组，与本模组 100% 兼容，可同时加载。
translations.gameplay_zh_current:
• 创建新物种时，在舰船类型中选择「Ancient（远古）」即可使用。
• 纯外观类模组，不改变平衡数值，新旧存档均可使用。
• 与其他舰船/种族模组兼容性良好，作者系列舰船模组可叠加使用。
